verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a CLI, a server and a built-in web UI, so asking whether it offers configurable task-specific assistants is fair for this kind of product. The evidence pack, however, never mentions custom assistants, saved presets or per-task system-prompt profiles. GBNF grammars only constrain output format, which is an adjacent feature, not the ability to create custom assistants.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks
